remarks: Discover luxurious California living in this spacious, single story 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo. The kitchen is updated with newer cabinetry and Carrara Marble counters-tops, and with newer appliances, then relax in a cozy and calm open floor plan environment around a newer electric fireplace. Unwind in the tub-equipped bathroom, accessible from the living room and each bedroom. The bedrooms are abundant with closet space and storage. The outdoors has an expansive outdoor patio (39 ft. by 14 ft. ) ideal for al fresco dining or lounging amidst lush planters and stylish outdoor furniture.
